tricky_cases_explained: Tricky Case 1: RC-1 (NULL_USER_ON_LOGIN) vs RC-7 (ORG_SETTINGS_NULL_AVATAR) share identical messages ('reading avatar_url') across completely different application modules.
Tricky Case 2: RC-8 (REDIS_CACHE_PARTITION_DESYNC) manifests in 4 totally disjoint stack traces (WebSocket, HTTP Auth, Celery Worker, GraphQL Directive).

RC-1.name: NULL_USER_ON_LOGIN
RC-1.title: Null user object during login authentication callback
RC-1.description: User credential verification returns null profile under edge-case auth flows, crashing session init.
RC-1.tricky_note: Tricky Case 1A: Almost identical wording to RC-7 ('reading avatar_url' or 'reading id'), but distinct root cause (Auth vs Org Settings).
message_templates: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'id')
TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'email')
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'avatar_url')
TypeError: user is null, unable to resolve credentials for session {uid}
Cannot destructure property 'token' of undefined or null at login callback

RC-2.name: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT
RC-2.title: Upstream payment gateway timeout during checkout charge confirmation
RC-2.description: Third-party payment gateway fails to respond within 15s deadline during card authorization.

TimeoutError: Request to payment capture endpoint timed out
